title: The Fake Prize at Skyfest
intro: At the hot-air balloon festival, the golden trophy for Best Balloon has been swapped for a painted plaster copy just before the judges arrive.

suspects.name: Lena
suspects.line: I was fixing a rope. Ask the rigging crew.

suspects.name: Tobias
suspects.line: The judges' tent? Never been near it.

suspects.name: Marta
suspects.line: I was checking my burner, nothing else!

suspects.name: Gus
suspects.line: Ask me about wind speeds, I'll talk all day.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I only came for the candyfloss, honest.

clues.text: The candyfloss seller swears the culprit never came near his stall. Sticky evidence suggests they were not the one at the candyfloss stall.
A witness saw someone in white trainers and ruled them out fast: the culprit is not the one in white trainers, whose shoes were spotless all morning.
A bandana was found tangled on a tent peg, but its owner was seen at the rides all afternoon. The culprit is not the bandana wearer.
Fresh boot prints in the mud led straight to the trophy tent. The culprit wore brown boots, and the tread was unmistakable.
